method: Each symbol of the universe file is classified the same way, from metadata only (no price, volume or funding value). 1) Binance exchangeInfo (GET https://fapi.binance.com/fapi/v1/exchangeInfo, serverTime 1791800677283): underlyingType EQUITY, HK_EQUITY, KR_EQUITY or CN_EQUITY is equity, refined by the contract's Binance launch announcement to etf_or_etp when its underlying is named as an ETF, ETP, index fund, trust or leveraged product (or is a ProShares, Direxion, GraniteShares or Tradr daily product), and to private_company when the announcement is a Pre-IPO contract; PREMARKET is private_company, COMMODITY commodity, FX fiat_pegged_or_fx, INDEX index. COIN is crypto unless the token CoinGecko maps the contract to sits in a stablecoin, commodity-backed or tokenized-securities category and its record confirms it was pegged or backed at the contract's listing. 2) A contract exchangeInfo no longer lists is classified from its Binance futures listing or delisting announcement (an index contract from its index launch). 3) Failing both, a CoinGecko registry entry. A symbol none of these verifies as a crypto-native token is unverified.
